name: Scion of the Blazing Sun
effectTemplate: After a Charged Attack hits an opponent, a Sunfire Arrow will descend upon the opponent hit, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color> ATK as DMG, and applying the Heartsearer effect to the opponent damaged by said Arrow for 10s.
